text_en: When Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he assembled one hundred eighty thousand chosen troops of the house of Judah and Benjamin to fight against Israel, to restore the kingdom to Rehoboam.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕一回到耶路撒冷，即刻召集犹大和本雅明家族中十八万善战的精兵，去攻打以色列，想把王国夺回，再归属勒哈贝罕。

text_en: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah the man of God:
text_cn: 但是，上主有话传于天主的人舍玛雅说：

text_en: Say to King Rehoboam of Judah, son of Solomon, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,
text_cn: “你去告诉撒罗满的儿子犹大王勒哈贝罕，及所有犹大和本雅明的以色列人说：

text_en: “Thus says the Lord : You shall not go up or fight against your kindred. Let everyone return home, for this thing is from me. ” So they heeded the word of the Lord and turned back from the expedition against Jeroboam.
text_cn: 上主这样说：你们不可前去攻打你们的弟兄！你们各人回本家吧！因为这事是出于我。”他们便听从了上主的话，都回去了，没有去攻打雅洛贝罕。

text_en: Rehoboam resided in Jerusalem, and he built cities for defense in Judah.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕住在耶路撒冷，在犹大修筑了各城的防御工事，

text_en: He built up Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
text_cn: 即修筑了白冷、厄坦、特科亚、

text_en: Beth-zur, Soco, Adullam,
text_cn: 贝特族尔、索苛、阿杜蓝、

text_en: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
text_cn: 加特、玛勒沙、齐弗、

text_en: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
text_cn: 阿多兰、拉基士、阿则卡、

text_en: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, fortified cities that are in Judah and in Benjamin.
text_cn: 祚辣、阿雅隆和赫贝龙：这些都是犹大和本雅明境内设防的城。

text_en: He made the fortresses strong, and put commanders in them, and stores of food, oil, and wine.
text_cn: 他加强巩固这些城，派军驻守，储备食粮，酒、油；

text_en: He also put large shields and spears in all the cities, and made them very strong. So he held Judah and Benjamin.
text_cn: 各城内又备有干戈，使之极其坚固，为统治犹大和本雅明。

text_en: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel presented themselves to him from all their territories.
text_cn: 凡以色列所有的司祭和肋未人都由各地来归勒哈贝罕。

text_en: The Levites had left their common lands and their holdings and had come to Judah and Jerusalem, because Jeroboam and his sons had prevented them from serving as priests of the Lord ,
text_cn: 肋未人离开自己的牧场和产业，来到犹大和耶路撒冷，是因为雅洛贝罕和他的儿子们拒绝他们充当司祭，服事上主，

text_en: and had appointed his own priests for the high places, and for the goat-demons, and for the calves that he had made.
text_cn: 而另为高丘、公山羊像和自己所制的牛犊委派了司祭。

text_en: Those who had set their hearts to seek the Lord God of Israel came after them from all the tribes of Israel to Jerusalem to sacrifice to the Lord , the God of their ancestors.
text_cn: 为此，以色列各支派中，凡专心寻求上主以色列天主的，都随那些肋未人到了耶路撒冷，向上主他们祖先的天主奉献牺牲。

text_en: They strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and for three years they made Rehoboam son of Solomon secure, for they walked for three years in the way of David and Solomon.
text_cn: 如此，这般人加强了犹大的国势，使撒罗满的儿子勒哈贝罕有了势力，凡三年之久，因为他们在三年之中，遵循了达味和撒罗满的道路。

text_en: Rehoboam took as his wife Mahalath daughter of Jerimoth son of David, and of Abihail daughter of Eliab son of Jesse.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕娶了达味之子耶黎摩特的女儿，亦即叶瑟之子厄里雅布的女儿阿彼海耳的女儿玛哈拉特为妻。

text_en: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
text_cn: 玛哈拉特给他生的儿子，即耶乌士、舍玛黎雅和匝罕。

text_en: After her he took Maacah daughter of Absalom, who bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
text_cn: 以后，他又娶了阿贝沙隆的外孙女玛阿加，她生了阿彼雅、阿泰、齐匝和舍罗米特。

text_en: Rehoboam loved Maacah daughter of Absalom more than all his other wives and concubines (he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters).
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕共娶了十八个妻子，六十个妾侍，生了二十八个儿子，六十个女儿；但他爱阿贝沙隆的外孙女玛阿加，超过其他的妻妾。

text_en: Rehoboam appointed Abijah son of Maacah as chief prince among his brothers, for he intended to make him king.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕遂将玛阿加的儿子阿彼雅立为储君，为众兄弟之长，有意立他为王。

text_en: He dealt wisely, and distributed some of his sons through all the districts of Judah and Benjamin, in all the fortified cities; he gave them abundant provisions, and found many wives for them.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕作事聪明，将他所有的儿子分派在犹大和本雅明全境所有设防的城内，供给他们丰富食粮，并给他们娶了许多妻妾。
